Strategy: Pair items only when few bins are open. With fewer than five bins, aim for a leftover of one item; with many bins open, tightness alone decides. Score by distance from a leftover of one item when few, by Best Fit otherwise, exact fits tied at the top, so ranking switches from Best Fit only when few bins are open. It may help by pairing when options are scarce, but may fail by ignoring pairing when many bins compete.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(abs(r - item - item)) + (item if r - item == 0 else 0) if len(bins) < 5 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Count-conditional pairing: pairing target when len(bins) < 5, else Best Fit.
